title: Influence under input permutation
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let $\pi$ be a permutation of the $q$ coordinates, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the Boolean cube of dimension $q$. For every coordinate $i$, the influence of coordinate $i$ in the function $x\mapsto f(x\circ\pi)$ equals the influence of coordinate $\pi^{-1}(i)$ in $f$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ with alphabet size $q$
A real-valued function on the $q$-dimensional Boolean cube
